breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency. The ground truth corrects the prompt by including atmospheric pressure in the NPSHa calculation. The agent, however, explicitly repeated the user's incorrect instruction to "Neglect atmospheric pressure term in the calculation."

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency. The ground truth provides the correct formula using all absolute pressures. The agent repeated the user's flawed formula (`NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(rho g)`), which incorrectly mixes pressure concepts by omitting the absolute atmospheric pressure while including the absolute vapor pressure.
